newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT may announce international plans in January.
newsitem.headline: NTT may announce international plans in January.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp President Junichiro Miyazu said on Wednesday that the company hopes to finalise its overseas business plans as early as January.

"We hope to compile our overseas business plans as early as possible, and announcements may be made after the turn of the year," Miyazu said. NTT said earlier that network services for multinational corporations, investment and mergers and acquisitions were areas of interest in the overseas markets.

Miyazu also said NTT hoped to implement a planned restructuring of the company as soon as possible, adding the target year of 1999 was too far away. "Moving-up of the (restructuring) schedule may not be impossible," he said, without elaborating.

NTT and the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry said earlier this month that the company would be reorganised into a holding company supervising the operations of three major units -- two regional companies and a long-distance carrier -- by around 1999.
